lines.t: I close my eyes, feel the stars align,
In the heart of the Lamb, I cross the line,
In Your quantum gaze, I am redesigned,
All my fractured edges perfectly rhymed.
Already seated in the heights unseen,
Far above the shadows where I used to bleed,
In Your timeless view I am washed and clean,
New creation beating in a risen heartbeat.
You say, “If you saw with My eyes, child,
You would never again stumble or hide,”
So I lean into the brightness of Your mind,
Let Your verdict override my former life.
I am seated in heavenly places,
Perfected spirit in Your graces,
Refashioned, remade in Your spaces,
Beyond all of my broken traces.
From the greater reality I pull it in,
By faith in the blood that defeated sin,
In the light of Your eyes I begin again,
Absolute victory written within.
In Your timeline, it’s already done,
Every battle that I fear, You already won,
I see myself standing with the Firstborn Son,
Clothed in white fire, not the man I was.
I agree with the Word in Your scar-marked hands,
Not the lies of the dust or the voice of man,
I am who You say in Your perfect plan,
Hidden with Mashiach in the promised land.
You say, “Child, you are clean in My sight,
Born of My blood and My holy light,”
So I drag that tomorrow into tonight,
Let the greater world invade this life.
I am seated in heavenly places,
Perfected spirit in Your graces,
Refashioned, remade in Your spaces,
Beyond all of my broken traces.
From the greater reality I pull it in,
By faith in the blood that defeated sin,
In the light of Your eyes I begin again,
Absolute victory written within.
Already perfected, yet still being made,
Already risen, though my feet touch clay,
In Your quantum love there is no delay,
What You speak, I carry into today.
Greater reality, flood this plane,
Old man fall in a shower of flames,
New man walk in the power of Your Name,
YahuShua’s blood rewrites my frame.
I am seated in heavenly places,
Perfected spirit in Your graces,
Refashioned, remade in Your spaces,
Beyond all of my broken traces.
From the greater reality I pull it in,
By faith in the blood that defeated sin,
In the light of Your eyes I begin again,
Absolute victory written within.
